data.name: THE WOLF OF TENGRI
data.detailed_description:
WOLF OF TENGRI

The ancient spirits have awakened. The balance of the world is collapsing.

Enter a cinematic third-person Action RPG inspired by the rich mythology of the ancient Turks. Explore a vast semi-open world filled with forgotten temples, sacred mountains, hidden forests, and mysterious ruins where every path reveals a new legend.

Face terrifying mythical creatures, master fast and brutal melee combat, discover powerful relics, and forge your own destiny. Every battle, every discovery, and every decision brings you closer to restoring the balance—or plunging the world into darkness.

KEY FEATURES

  • Fast-paced third-person melee combat inspired by modern action RPGs

  • Explore a vast interconnected semi-open world

  • Battle legendary creatures, corrupted spirits, and powerful bosses

  • Discover forgotten civilizations and ancient Turkic relics

  • Unlock powerful abilities and customize your combat style

  • Experience a story inspired by Turkic mythology, Tengri belief, and shamanic traditions

  • Stunning cinematic presentation powered by Unreal Engine 5

  • Full keyboard, mouse, and controller support

EXPLORE THE WORLD OF TENGRI

Journey through breathtaking landscapes where every mountain, temple, and forgotten ruin hides ancient secrets. Encounter mysterious tribes, mythical guardians, sacred spirits, and lost knowledge waiting to be uncovered.

From dense forests to towering peaks and abandoned sanctuaries, every location has its own history, dangers, and rewards.

MASTER THE WAY OF THE WARRIOR

Combat is built around precision, timing, and skill.

Chain devastating melee combos, dodge deadly attacks, master powerful abilities, and adapt your fighting style against unique enemies and legendary bosses.

Your equipment, relics, and choices will determine the warrior you become.

AN ANCIENT LEGEND RETURNS

The spirits are watching.

The old gods have fallen silent.

The balance is fading.

Will you become the Wolf of Tengri...

...or allow darkness to consume the world?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8 GB
  • Storage: 40 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
